rows.grounds: expresses attainment of the desired result
qualifies the desired object as manifold
relative pronoun introducing the desired object
denotes what is intended or wished for

items.question: Is attainment of whatever various goals are desired guaranteed without doubt?
premises: The verb labhati asserts actual attainment of an outcome.
The phrase na sandehaḥ explicitly excludes doubt about this attainment.
The object vividhaṃ yat samīhitam refers to any various desired goal.
items.inference: Therefore, one certainly attains whatever various goal is desired, without any doubt.
uncertainties: The subject of labhati is implicit and understood from the preceding context.
items.plain_english: One indeed obtains whatever various thing is desired; there is no doubt.
